content: commanded-ecto-projections uses Ecto.Multi for atomic projection writes. The library records the last seen event position within the same transaction as data mutations, enabling idempotency. Schema prefix support via schema_prefix option. No per-projection isolated migration history out of the box — migrations are managed via the application's shared Ecto repo. Per-projection isolated migrations (each projection owns its table AND its migration tracking) is an advanced pattern not natively supported by commanded-ecto-projections; requires custom migration runner per projection repo.
